text: Last week, we celebrated my little sister's birthday. It is a family tradition to make a big cake with candles for every birthday. My mother invited many guests, and we decorated the house with colorful flags and balloons. When the guests arrived, we sang a happy song for my sister. She was very surprised and smiled a lot. It was a wonderful surprise for her because she did not know about the party. After we sang, everyone made a wish for her happiness. We ate the cake and danced to music until night. In my country, this custom of singing and eating cake is very common at every birthday party. We also have other festivals during the year, like the New Year festival, when families come together and celebrate with food and gifts. On these holidays, children usually receive small gifts from their family. I love holidays because they bring family and friends together. This year, I want to give my sister a special gift for her next birthday and make her feel happy again.
